blueprints.accuracy_notes: Official Porsche line drawing with dimensions in mm, 992 (red) vs 991.2 (grey): length 4519/4499, wheelbase 2450/2450, height 1298/1294, front tyre dia 671/671, rear tyre dia 715/690 (so this is the Carrera S on 21-inch rears), front axle to heel point 432. NOT TO SCALE: measured wheelbase 872 px vs length ~1527 px gives L/WB 1.75 while true 4519/2450 = 1.84 (drawing traced from a perspective view). Use numbers, not pixels.

blueprints.accuracy_notes: Near-side-on render with perspective: image L/WB = 3211/1826 px = 1.759 vs true 4519/2450 = 1.844 (~4.6 % shortening of the ends). Hub-cap centres at x=956 / 2782 px. Best available official 992.1 base-Carrera side image; do not scale-measure without correction.
Same camera as above: body 81-1836 px, hubs 463/1458 px -> L/WB 1.763 vs 1.844 true. Transparent background makes silhouette extraction easy.
Straight-on rear with perspective; shows full-width light bar, black louvres + '11' brake light, single oval tailpipe each side, plate between tailpipes.
Overhead with visible perspective (car slightly rotated); plan-view reference for bonnet recess, mirrors, fuel flap (right front wing).

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
